fact: AIMF reports that FEICOM presented Inform'All City on 21 March 2023, a platform on which informal traders register and pay their local tax, against a site the commune assigns them, so that councils collect remotely.
AIMF reports that Inform'All City is to be deployed first in the councils of Yaoundé II and Douala III, the political and economic capitals, with no wider count given.
